Markdown.doc: A scrolling widget that parses and displays Markdown.

selectable.doc: If true, the text is selectable.

styleSheet.doc: The styles to use when displaying the Markdown.

styleSheetTheme.doc: Setting to specify base theme for MarkdownStyleSheet

onSelectionChanged.doc: Called when the user changes selection when [selectable] is set to true.

onTapLink.doc: Called when the user taps a link.

onTapText.doc: Default tap handler used when [selectable] is set to true

imageDirectory.doc: The base directory holding images referenced by Img tags with local or network file paths.

listItemCrossAxisAlignment.doc:
Controls the cross axis alignment for the bullet and list item content
in lists.

padding.doc: The amount of space by which to inset the children.

controller.doc: An object that can be used to control the position to which this scroll view is scrolled.

physics.doc: How the scroll view should respond to user input.

shrinkWrap.doc:
Whether the extent of the scroll view in the scroll direction should be
determined by the contents being viewed.

noScroll.doc:
If true, the markdown is rendered in a non-scrolling [Column] instead of
a scrolling [ListView]. Use this when the widget is already inside a
scrolling parent.

softLineBreak.doc:
The soft line break is used to identify the spaces at the end of aline of
text and the leading spaces in the immediately following the line of text.

onSelectionChanged: 3 callback args cross as one array payload

MarkdownBody.doc: A non-scrolling widget that parses and displays Markdown.

selectable.doc: If true, the text is selectable.

styleSheet.doc: The styles to use when displaying the Markdown.

styleSheetTheme.doc: Setting to specify base theme for MarkdownStyleSheet

onSelectionChanged.doc: Called when the user changes selection when [selectable] is set to true.

onTapLink.doc: Called when the user taps a link.

onTapText.doc: Default tap handler used when [selectable] is set to true

imageDirectory.doc: The base directory holding images referenced by Img tags with local or network file paths.

listItemCrossAxisAlignment.doc:
Controls the cross axis alignment for the bullet and list item content
in lists.

shrinkWrap.doc:
If [shrinkWrap] is `true`, [MarkdownBody] will take the minimum height
that wraps its content. Otherwise, [MarkdownBody] will expand to the
maximum allowed height.

fitContent.doc: Whether to allow the widget to fit the child content.

softLineBreak.doc:
The soft line break is used to identify the spaces at the end of aline of
text and the leading spaces in the immediately following the line of text.

BlendMode.doc: Algorithms to use when painting on the canvas.

BlurStyle.doc: Styles to use for blurs in [MaskFilter] objects.

BorderStyle.doc: The style of line to draw for a [BorderSide] in a [Border].

BottomNavigationBarLandscapeLayout.doc:
Refines the layout of a [BottomNavigationBar] when the enclosing
[MediaQueryData.orientation] is [Orientation.landscape].

BottomNavigationBarType.doc: Defines the layout and behavior of a [BottomNavigationBar].

BoxFit.doc: How a box should be inscribed into another box.

BoxShape.doc: The shape to use when rendering a [Border] or [BoxDecoration].

Brightness.doc: Describes the contrast of a theme or color palette.

ButtonBarLayoutBehavior.doc:
Used with [ButtonTheme] and [ButtonThemeData] to define how the button bar
should size itself with either constraints or internal padding.

ButtonTextTheme.doc:
Used with [ButtonTheme] and [ButtonThemeData] to define a button's base
colors, and the defaults for the button's minimum size, internal padding,
and shape.

ColorSpace.doc: The color space describes the colors that are available to an [Image].

DismissDirection.doc: The direction in which a [Dismissible] can be dismissed.

DynamicSchemeVariant.doc: The algorithm used to construct a [ColorScheme] in [ColorScheme.fromSeed].

FilterQuality.doc:
Quality levels for image sampling in [ImageFilter] and [Shader] objects that sample
images and for [Canvas] operations that render images.

FlutterLogoStyle.doc: Possible ways to draw Flutter's logo.

FontStyle.doc: Whether to use the italic type variation of glyphs in the font.

IconAlignment.doc:
Determines the alignment of the icon within the widgets such as:
  - [ElevatedButton.icon],
  - [FilledButton.icon],
  - [FilledButton.tonalIcon].
  - [OutlinedButton.icon],
  - [TextButton.icon],

ImageRepeat.doc: How to paint any portions of a box not covered by an image.

ListTileControlAffinity.doc:
Where to place the control in widgets that use [ListTile] to position a
control next to a label.

ListTileStyle.doc: Defines the title font used for [ListTile] descendants of a [ListTileTheme].

ListTileTitleAlignment.doc:
Defines how [ListTile.leading] and [ListTile.trailing] are
vertically aligned relative to the [ListTile]'s titles
([ListTile.title] and [ListTile.subtitle]).

MainAxisAlignment.doc: How the children should be placed along the main axis in a flex layout.

MarkdownListItemCrossAxisAlignment.doc: Enumeration of alignment strategies for the cross axis of list items.

MarkdownStyleSheetBaseTheme.doc: Enum to specify which theme being used when creating [MarkdownStyleSheet]

MaterialTapTargetSize.doc: Configures the tap target and layout size of certain Material widgets.

NavigationDestinationLabelBehavior.doc: Specifies when each [NavigationDestination]'s label should appear.

NavigationRailLabelType.doc: Defines the behavior of the labels of a [NavigationRail].

PopupMenuPosition.doc: Used to configure how the [PopupMenuButton] positions its popup menu.

ScrollDecelerationRate.doc: The rate at which scroll momentum will be decelerated.

SelectionChangedCause.doc:
Indicates what triggered the change in selected text (including changes to
the cursor location).

ShowValueIndicator.doc:
Describes the conditions under which the value indicator on a [Slider]
will be shown. Used in [Slider.showValueIndicator] and
[SliderThemeData.showValueIndicator].

SliderInteraction.doc: Possible ways for a user to interact with a [Slider].

SnackBarBehavior.doc:
Defines where a [SnackBar] should appear within a [Scaffold] and how its
location should be adjusted when the scaffold also includes a
[FloatingActionButton] or a [BottomNavigationBar].

StrokeCap.doc: Styles to use for line endings.

TabAlignment.doc: Defines how tabs are aligned horizontally in a [TabBar].

TabBarIndicatorSize.doc: Defines how the bounds of the selected tab indicator are computed.

TabIndicatorAnimation.doc: Defines how the tab indicator animates when the selected tab changes.

TableCellVerticalAlignment.doc: Vertical alignment options for cells in [RenderTable] objects.

TargetPlatform.doc: The platform that user interaction should adapt to target.

TextAffinity.doc:
A way to disambiguate a [TextPosition] when its offset could match two
different locations in the rendered string.

TextAlign.doc: Whether and how to align text horizontally.

TextBaseline.doc: A horizontal line used for aligning text.

TextCapitalization.doc:
Configures how the platform keyboard will select an uppercase or
lowercase keyboard.

TextDecorationStyle.doc: The style in which to draw a text decoration

TextOverflow.doc: How overflowing text should be handled.

TileMode.doc: Defines how to handle areas outside the defined bounds of a gradient or image filter.

TooltipTriggerMode.doc: How touch events should trigger a tooltip.

WebHtmlElementStrategy.doc:
The strategy for [Image.network] and [NetworkImage] to decide whether to
display images in HTML elements contained in a platform view instead of
fetching bytes.

ActionIconThemeData.doc:
A [ActionIconThemeData] that overrides the default icons of
[BackButton], [CloseButton], [DrawerButton], and [EndDrawerButton] with
[ActionIconTheme.of] or the overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.actionIconTheme].

AdaptationOfObject.doc: Defines a customized theme for components with an `adaptive` factory constructor.

AlignmentGeometry.doc:
Base class for [Alignment] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

AnimationStyle.doc: Used to override the default parameters of an animation.

AssetBundle.doc: A collection of resources used by the application.

BadgeThemeData.doc: Overrides the default properties values for descendant [Badge] widgets.

BorderRadius.doc: An immutable set of radii for each corner of a rectangle.

BorderRadiusGeometry.doc: Base class for [BorderRadius] that allows for text-direction aware resolution.

BorderSide.doc: A side of a border of a box.

BottomAppBarThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [BottomAppBar] widgets.

BottomNavigationBarThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [BottomNavigationBar]
widgets.

BoxBorder.doc:
Base class for box borders that can paint as rectangles, circles, or rounded
rectangles.

BoxDecoration.doc: An immutable description of how to paint a box.

BoxShadow.doc: A shadow cast by a box.

ButtonStyle.doc: The visual properties that most buttons have in common.

ButtonThemeData.doc: Used with [ButtonTheme] to configure the color and geometry of buttons.

CardThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Card] widgets.

CarouselViewThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [CarouselView] widgets.

CheckboxThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Checkbox] widgets.

ChipThemeData.doc: Holds the color, shape, and text styles for a Material Design chip theme.

Color.doc: An immutable color value in ARGB format.

ColorFilter.doc:
A description of a color filter to apply when drawing a shape or compositing
a layer with a particular [Paint]. A color filter is a function that takes
two colors, and outputs one color. When applied during compositing, it is
independently applied to each pixel of the layer being drawn before the
entire layer is merged with the destination.

ColorScheme.doc:
A set of 45 colors based on the
[Material spec](https://m3.material.io/styles/color/the-color-system/color-roles)
that can be used to configure the color properties of most components.

Curve.doc:
An parametric animation easing curve, i.e. a mapping of the unit interval to
the unit interval.

DataTableThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [DataTable]
widgets.

DatePickerThemeData.doc:
Overrides the default values of visual properties for descendant
[DatePickerDialog] widgets.

Decoration.doc: A description of a box decoration (a decoration applied to a [Rect]).

DecorationImage.doc: An image for a box decoration.

DialogThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Dialog] widgets.

DividerThemeData.doc:
Defines the visual properties of [Divider], [VerticalDivider], dividers
between [ListTile]s, and dividers between rows in [DataTable]s.

DrawerThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Drawer] widgets.

DropdownMenuThemeData.doc: Overrides the default values of visual properties for descendant [DropdownMenu] widgets.

Duration.doc: A difference between points in time.

EdgeInsets.doc: An immutable set of offsets in each of the four cardinal directions.

EdgeInsetsGeometry.doc:
Base class for [EdgeInsets] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

ElevatedButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] that overrides the default appearance of
[ElevatedButton]s when it's used with [ElevatedButtonTheme] or with the
overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.elevatedButtonTheme].

ExpansionTileThemeData.doc:
Used with [ExpansionTileTheme] to define default property values for
descendant [ExpansionTile] widgets.

FilledButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] that overrides the default appearance of
[FilledButton]s when it's used with [FilledButtonTheme] or with the
overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.filledButtonTheme].

FloatingActionButtonThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [FloatingActionButton]
widgets.

FontFeature.doc: A feature tag and value that affect the selection of glyphs in a font.

FontVariation.doc: An axis tag and value that can be used to customize variable fonts.

FontWeight.doc: The thickness of the glyphs used to draw the text.

GradientTransform.doc:
Base class for transforming gradient shaders without applying the same
transform to the entire canvas.

IconButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] that overrides the default appearance of
[IconButton]s when it's used with the [IconButton], the [IconButtonTheme] or the
overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.iconButtonTheme].

IconThemeData.doc: Defines the size, font variations, color, opacity, and shadows of icons.

ImageProviderOfObject.doc:
Identifies an image without committing to the precise final asset. This
allows a set of images to be identified and for the precise image to later
be resolved based on the environment, e.g. the device pixel ratio.

LinearBorderEdge.doc: Defines the relative size and alignment of one [LinearBorder] edge.

ListTileThemeData.doc:
Used with [ListTileTheme] to define default property values for
descendant [ListTile] widgets, as well as classes that build
[ListTile]s, like [CheckboxListTile], [RadioListTile], and
[SwitchListTile].

Locale.doc: An identifier used to select a user's language and formatting preferences.

MarkdownStyleSheet.doc: Defines which [TextStyle] objects to use for which Markdown elements.

MaterialBannerThemeData.doc: Defines the visual properties of [MaterialBanner] widgets.

MaterialColor.doc: Defines a single color as well a color swatch with ten shades of the color.

MenuBarThemeData.doc:
A data class that [MenuBarTheme] uses to define the visual properties of
[MenuBar] widgets.

MenuButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] theme that overrides the default appearance of
[SubmenuButton]s and [MenuItemButton]s.

MenuStyle.doc: The visual properties that menus have in common.

MenuThemeData.doc:
Defines the configuration of the submenus created by the [SubmenuButton],
[MenuBar], or [MenuAnchor] widgets.

MouseCursor.doc: An interface for mouse cursor definitions.

NavigationBarThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [NavigationBar]
widgets.

NavigationDrawerThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [NavigationDrawer]
widgets.

NavigationRailThemeData.doc:
Defines default property values for descendant [NavigationRail]
widgets.

NoDefaultCupertinoThemeData.doc:
Styling specifications for a cupertino theme without default values for
unspecified properties.

NotchedShape.doc: A shape with a notch in its outline.

OutlinedBorder.doc:
A ShapeBorder that draws an outline with the width and color specified
by [side].

OutlinedButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] that overrides the default appearance of
[OutlinedButton]s when it's used with [OutlinedButtonTheme] or with the
overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.outlinedButtonTheme].

PageTransitionsBuilder.doc: Defines a page transition animation for a [PageRoute].

PageTransitionsTheme.doc:
Defines the page transition animations used by [MaterialPageRoute]
for different [TargetPlatform]s.

Paint.doc: A description of the style to use when drawing on a [Canvas].

PopupMenuThemeData.doc:
Defines the visual properties of the routes used to display popup menus
as well as [PopupMenuItem] and [PopupMenuDivider] widgets.

ProgressIndicatorThemeData.doc:
Overrides the default values of visual properties for descendant
[ProgressIndicator] widgets.

RadioThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Radio] widgets.

Radius.doc: A radius for either circular or elliptical shapes.

RangeSliderTickMarkShape.doc: Base class for [RangeSlider] tick mark shapes.

RangeSliderValueIndicatorShape.doc: Base class for [RangeSlider] value indicator shapes.

Rect.doc:
An immutable, 2D, axis-aligned, floating-point rectangle whose coordinates
are relative to a given origin.

ScrollPhysics.doc: Determines the physics of a [Scrollable] widget.

ScrollbarThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Scrollbar] widgets.

SearchBarThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [SearchBar] widgets.

SearchViewThemeData.doc:
Defines the configuration of the search views created by the [SearchAnchor]
widget.

SegmentedButtonThemeData.doc:
Overrides the default values of visual properties for descendant
[SegmentedButton] widgets.

SliderComponentShape.doc: Base class for slider thumb, thumb overlay, and value indicator shapes.

SliderThemeData.doc:
Overrides the default values of visual properties for descendant
[Slider] widgets.

SliderTickMarkShape.doc: Base class for [Slider] tick mark shapes.

SliderTrackShape.doc: Base class for slider track shapes.

SnackBarThemeData.doc: Customizes default property values for [SnackBar] widgets.

SwitchThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Switch] widgets.

TabBarThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [TabBar] widgets.

TableColumnWidth.doc: Base class to describe how wide a column in a [RenderTable] should be.

TextButtonThemeData.doc:
A [ButtonStyle] that overrides the default appearance of
[TextButton]s when it's used with [TextButtonTheme] or with the
overall [Theme]'s [ThemeData.textButtonTheme].

TextDecoration.doc: A linear decoration to draw near the text.

TextScaler.doc:
A class that describes how textual contents should be scaled for better
readability.

TextSelectionThemeData.doc:
Defines the text selection visual properties for descendant [TextField] and
[SelectableText] widgets.

TextStyle.doc: An immutable style describing how to format and paint text.

ThemeData.doc:
Defines the configuration of the overall visual [Theme] for a [MaterialApp]
or a widget subtree within the app.

TimePickerThemeData.doc: Defines the visual properties of the widget displayed with [showTimePicker].

ToggleButtonsThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [ToggleButtons] widgets.

TooltipThemeData.doc: Defines default property values for descendant [Tooltip] widgets.

Typography.doc: The color and geometry [TextTheme]s for Material apps.

Uri.doc: A parsed URI, such as a URL.

ViewPadding.doc:
A representation of distances for each of the four edges of a rectangle,
used to encode the view insets and padding that applications should place
around their user interface, as exposed by [FlutterView.viewInsets] and
[FlutterView.padding]. View insets and padding are preferably read via
[MediaQuery.of].

VisualDensity.doc: Defines the visual density of user interface components.
